categories.rationale: P4 because it fixes a minor memory undercount that only affects locally submitted unbroadcast transactions. Because the unbroadcast set typically holds very few entries (each ~80 bytes), the omitted usage is negligible compared to the default 300 MB mempool limit.

result.card: This PR adds `m_unbroadcast_txids` into `CTxMemPool::DynamicMemoryUsage()` so that mempool memory accounting accounts for locally submitted transactions awaiting broadcast. The omitted memory is small (roughly 80 bytes per unbroadcast transaction), so the fix has minimal real-world impact on mempool limit enforcement. The PR has a tested ACK from jeanpablojp and is ready for merge.
